messages:
Ava M.: Quick sync on Cloud Connector co-marketing: launch post, benchmark narrative, joint webinar, and inbound routing. Aim to publish the week of 4/10. Who owns what?

Tom P.: I9ll lead partner comms + webinar ops. Proposed webinar week of 4/8. Format: 15m joint demo, 20m product talk, 10m Q&A. Need 2 benchmark slides (latency + cost).

Ravi S.: I9ll draft the launch blog and the benchmark write-up. Can eng-ml share perf metrics? @Ginger @Max please drop p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec for 4k context tests. :pray:

Jules R.: I9ll handle inbound routing. Basic spec:
```
- source: partner_signup_form
  partner: cloud-connector
  route_to: sales.connectors
  notify: slack:#sales-connector-leads
- source: webinar_reg
  partner: cloud-connector
  route_to: marketing-ops
  tag: webinar_reg
  webhook: https://hooks.internal/mql
```
Include partner opt-in flag.

MarketplaceBot: Draft partner listing uploaded: https://portal.internal/partners/cloud-connector/draft (access: marketing, partnerships)

Tom P.: Promo tracking: use UTM params utm_source=cloud-connector&utm_medium=co-marketing&utm_campaign=connector_launch. Hidden form field partner=cloud-connector. Webhook should map partner -> account.owner if present.

Ava M.: Action items: Ravi: blog + benchmarks by 2026-03-28. Tom: webinar runbook + slides by 2026-03-30. Jules: routing spec + webhook test by 2026-03-29. Align meeting 2026-03-24 10:00 PT (30m). :calendar:

Jules R.: Form payload for eng-ops: {"form_id":"connector_signup","fields":"email,company,partner,utm_campaign","post_submit_webhook":"https://hooks.internal/mql","mapping":"partner->metadata.partner,email->lead.email,company->lead.company"}. Will add rate-limit and spam honeypot, and post results to #marketing-ops.

Ravi S.: Benchmark plan: two prompts, 4k context, batch sizes 1 & 8, measure p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec and cost per 1k tokens. Need raw numbers from eng-ml by 3/25 to build the blog table and social callout.

Tom P.: CTA flow: registrants -> partner demo landing -> "Request Dedicated" CTA -> routes to sales queue. Partner landing to capture UTM + partner hidden field. I9ll sync with Sales Ops on SLA for demo handoff.

Ava M.: Messaging: "Predictable inference across environments 8ndash; lower unit cost without sacrificing latency." Ravi, draft two headline options (short + long). Include a social-sized benchmark image.

Tom P.: I9ll run webinar promo calendar: 3 nurture emails, 2 partner-shared posts, LinkedIn ads targeting platform/ML engineers.

Jules R.: Will run webhook test by 3/29 and post replay link + result in #marketing. Security sign-off required for webhook.

Ava M.: I9ll create Asana tasks and tag owners. Legal to review partner logos (Tom). Partner quote requested by 3/26 (Tom to coordinate).

Ravi S.: I9ll mock a partner quote stub to send for approval.

Tom P.: Noted. Also please ensure the landing form maps partner->account fields for routed leads.

Ava M.: Thanks everyone 50 see you on 3/24. I9ll drop calendar invite and attach the draft runbook."
